cards.ex: That's a great idea. I couldn't agree more!
cards.exUz: Bu ajoyib g'oya. Men to'liq qo'shilaman!
cards.uzDef: Bu fikrga to'liq roziman, degan ma'noni anglatadi.

cards.ex: My brother and I don't always see eye to eye on politics.
cards.exUz: Akam bilan siyosatda doim bir xil fikrda bo'lmaymiz.
cards.uzDef: Fikrlar bir xil bo'lganda, bir xil nuqtai nazarda bo'lish.

cards.ex: Let's make sure we're all on the same page before we start the project.
cards.exUz: Loyiha boshlashdan oldin hammamiz bir xil fikrda ekanligimizga ishonch hosil qilaylik.
cards.uzDef: Hamma bir xil narsani tushunishi va rozi bo'lishi.

cards.ex: With all due respect, I beg to differ with your assessment.
cards.exUz: Hurmatim bilan, sizning bahoingizga boshqacha fikrdaman.
cards.uzDef: Hurmat bilan boshqacha fikrda ekanligingizni bildirish.

cards.ex: The division of property became a major bone of contention during their divorce.
cards.exUz: Mulkni bo'lish ularning ajrashishida asosiy bahs mavzusiga aylandi.
cards.uzDef: Kelishmovchilik yoki bahsga sabab bo'ladigan narsa.

cards.ex: I have to take issue with what you said about my friend.
cards.exUz: Do'stim haqida aytganlaringizga noroziligimni bildirmoqchiman.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa bilan rozi bo'lmaslik va tanqid qilish.

cards.ex: The salary was a sticking point in the contract negotiations.
cards.exUz: Maosh shartnoma bo'yicha muzokaralarda to'siq bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Bitimga erishishda qiyinchilik tug'diradigan masala.

cards.ex: I'm of two minds about whether to go to the party or stay home.
cards.exUz: Partiyaga borish yoki uyda qolish haqida ikkilanib turibman.
cards.uzDef: Nimaga qaror qilishni bilmay, ikkilanib turish.

cards.ex: We've been arguing for hours; let's just agree to disagree.
cards.exUz: Soatlab bahslashdik; keling, shunchaki rozi bo'lib kelishmaslikka kelishib olaylik.
cards.uzDef: Fikrlashuvning imkoni yo'qligini tan olib, kelishmovchilikda qolishga rozi bo'lish.

cards.ex: Just because he's rich doesn't necessarily mean he's happy.
cards.exUz: U boy bo'lgani uchun, bu uning baxtli ekanligini anglatmaydi.
cards.uzDef: Bu shart emas yoki doim ham to'g'ri emas degan ma'noni bildiradi.

cards.ex: Even though everyone disagreed, she stood her ground and argued her point.
cards.exUz: Hamma rozi bo'lmasa ham, u o'z fikrida turdi va o'z nuqtai nazarini himoya qildi.
cards.uzDef: O'z fikringizni yoki pozitsiyangizni himoya qilish, taslim bo'lmaslik.

cards.ex: I take exception to the way you're speaking to me.
cards.exUz: Menga gapirayotgan uslubingizga qarshiman.
cards.uzDef: Norozilik bildirish, biror narsa bilan rozi bo'lmaslik.

cards.ex: I am in full agreement with your proposal.
cards.exUz: Men sizning taklifingizga to'liq roziman.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa bilan bir xil fikrda bo'lish, rozi bo'lish.

cards.ex: He's not lazy; on the contrary, he works very hard.
cards.exUz: U dangasa emas; aksincha, u juda ko'p ishlaydi.
cards.uzDef: Oldingi fikrga qarama-qarshi ekanligini ta'kidlash.

cards.ex: The budget cuts have become a major point of contention.
cards.exUz: Budjet qisqartirilishi asosiy bahs nuqtasiga aylandi.
cards.uzDef: Kelishmovchilik yoki bahsga sabab bo'ladigan aniq masala.

cards.ex: They were able to meet halfway and reach an agreement.
cards.exUz: Ular yarasha olishdi va kelishuvga erishishdi.
cards.uzDef: Kelishmovchilikni hal qilish uchun har bir tomon o'z pozitsiyasidan biroz voz kechishi.

cards.ex: I have my doubts about whether this plan will actually work.
cards.exUz: Bu reja haqiqatan ham ish berishiga shubhalanaman.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaga ishonchsizlik bildirish, shubhalanish.

cards.ex: Whether or not he's the best player is debatable.
cards.exUz: U eng yaxshi o'yinchi ekanligi yoki yo'qligi bahsli.
cards.uzDef: Bu haqiqat deb hisoblanmaydi, bahslashish mumkin degan ma'noni bildiradi.

cards.ex: If you want to keep your job, you need to toe the line.
cards.exUz: Agar ishingizni saqlab qolmoqchi bo'lsangiz, qoidalarga rioya qilishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Guruhning qoidalariga yoki fikrlariga itoat qilish, bo'ysunish.

cards.ex: I was going to go to the beach, but on second thought, I'll stay home.
cards.exUz: Sohilga bormoqchi edim, lekin qayta o'ylab, uyda qolaman.
cards.uzDef: Oldin aytilgan fikrni o'zgartirish, qayta ko'rib chiqish.

cards.ex: I agree with you to a certain extent, but I also have some reservations.
cards.exUz: Men sizga ma'lum darajada qo'shilaman, lekin menda ham ba'zi shubhalar bor.
cards.uzDef: To'liq emas, faqat qisman to'g'ri ekanligini bildirish.

cards.ex: His behaviour beggars belief; I can't understand why he did that.
cards.exUz: Uning xatti-harakatiga ishonish qiyin; Nima uchun bunday qilganini tushunmayman.
cards.uzDef: Bu juda yomon yoki aql bovar qilmas darajada, ishonish qiyin.

cards.ex: He said he was telling the truth, but I'm not convinced.
cards.exUz: U rost gapirayotganini aytdi, lekin men ishonmadim.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaning haqiqat ekanligiga ishonmaslik.

cards.ex: We had to reach a compromise to settle the dispute.
cards.exUz: Biz nizoni hal qilish uchun kelishuvga erishishimiz kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: Kelishmovchilikni hal qilish uchun har bir tomon o'z pozitsiyasidan biroz voz kechishi.

cards.ex: I think we should invest in renewable energy. I'm with you on that.
cards.exUz: Menimcha, qayta tiklanadigan energiyaga sarmoya kiritishimiz kerak. Bu borada siz bilanman.
cards.uzDef: Bu fikrga to'liq qo'shilishni bildiradi.

cards.ex: I don't mind helping out, but I draw the line at doing your work for you.
cards.exUz: Yordam berishga qarshi emasman, lekin sizning ishingizni siz uchun qilishga chegara qo'yaman.
cards.uzDef: Qabul qilinishi mumkin bo'lmagan chegarani belgilash.

cards.ex: I love classical music, but my brother prefers rock. Different strokes for different folks.
cards.exUz: Men klassik musiqani yaxshi ko'raman, lekin akam rokni afzal ko'radi. Har kimniki har xil.
cards.uzDef: Har kimning o'ziga xos xohishlari va afzalliklari borligini anglatadi.

cards.ex: I agree with you in principle, but I'm not sure if it's practical.
cards.exUz: Men sizga asosan qo'shilaman, lekin bu amaliy ekanligiga ishonchim komil emas.
cards.uzDef: Nazariy jihatdan rozi bo'lish, lekin amalda emas.

cards.ex: The meeting was unproductive, to put it mildly.
cards.exUz: Yig'ilish unumsiz edi, yumshoq qilib aytganda.
cards.uzDef: Voqeani kamaytirib ko'rsatish, haqiqat undan ham yomonroq ekanligini bildirish.

cards.ex: The decision has already been made, so it's a moot point now.
cards.exUz: Qaror allaqachon qabul qilingan, shuning uchun bu endi muhim bo'lmagan masala.
cards.uzDef: Endi ahamiyati yo'q bo'lgan, bahslashishga arzimaydigan masala.
